# Glowing Bobbleheads & Collector Checklist

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 22, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Apr 5, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e9e777dcda454780b8b0a10bd54f89f6~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Glowing Bobbleheads are identical to normal Bobbleheads but come in a glowing variant.

There is a 20% chance to obtain a Glowing Bobblehead from Mystery Bobblehead Boxes, with a 1% chance for a specific glowing bobblehead. Additionally, they have a less than 1% chance of appearing in the open world or as drops from Large Holiday Gift Boxes.

- Glowing Bobbleheads **can not** be used to craft Legendary Mod Boxes.
- Percepti-Bobble Perk Card does work with Glowing Bobbleheads
- Curator Perk Card does work with Glowing Bobbleheads
- Glowing Bobbleheads are tradeable.
